title: parasenecio mortonii
intro: Parasenecio mortonii, commonly known as the Prairie Coneflower or Morton's Ragwort, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Parasenecio mortonii include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
